prompts.title: Invitation to give a workshop

email.subject: Invitation to give a workshop
body: Dear Dr. Mitra,
I enjoyed your workshop at the convention last week.
I'd like to invite you to give a similar presentation to the employees at Gammite Enterprises.
When would you be available?
Also, please let me know what you will need for your presentation.
Klaus Lehmann
Manager, Gammite Enterprises
translationVi: Gửi Dr. Mitra,
Tôi rất thích buổi workshop của bạn tại hội nghị tuần trước.
Tôi muốn mời bạn thực hiện một bài trình bày tương tự cho nhân viên của Gammite Enterprises.
Khi nào bạn có thể tham gia?
Ngoài ra, vui lòng cho tôi biết bạn cần gì cho bài trình bày.
Klaus Lehmann
Quản lý, Gammite Enterprises

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, give THREE pieces of information.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là Dr. Mitra, người được mời đến thuyết trình.

tasks.label: Information 1
tasks.requirement: Say whether you can give the workshop.
tasks.example: I would be happy to give a similar presentation.

tasks.label: Information 2
tasks.requirement: Say when you are available.
tasks.example: I am available on June 20 or June 21.

tasks.label: Information 3
tasks.requirement: Say what you need for the presentation.
tasks.example: I will need a projector and a large screen.

vocabulary.example: The company should allow employees to work from home twice a week.

vocabulary.meaningVi: cho thêm thời gian nghỉ phép
vocabulary.example: Another suggestion is to give employees more vacation time.

vocabulary.meaningVi: có thời gian cho việc gì
vocabulary.example: I am available for the meeting on Friday.
I need time to prepare for the presentation.

patterns: For the presentation, I will need ...
sampleAnswer: Dear Mr. Lehmann,
Thank you for inviting me to speak at Gammite Enterprises.
I would be happy to give a similar presentation to your employees.
I am available on June 20 or June 21.
For the presentation, I will need a projector and a large screen.
Please let me know which date works best for you.
Best regards,
A. Mitra

prompts.title: Customer satisfaction

email.subject: Customer satisfaction
body: Your office recently stopped using our company for your gardening and landscaping needs.
Customer service is very important to us, so we would like to hear from you.
Please tell us why you canceled your service and how you think we might better serve our customers in the future.
translationVi: Văn phòng của quý vị gần đây đã ngừng sử dụng dịch vụ làm vườn và cảnh quan của chúng tôi.
Dịch vụ khách hàng rất quan trọng với chúng tôi, nên chúng tôi muốn nghe ý kiến từ quý vị.
Vui lòng cho chúng tôi biết vì sao quý vị hủy dịch vụ và cách chúng tôi có thể phục vụ khách hàng tốt hơn.

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, provide TWO reasons and make ONE suggestion.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là đại diện Landerson Law Offices phản hồi công ty cảnh quan.

tasks.label: Reason 1
tasks.requirement: Give one reason for canceling the service.
tasks.example: The monthly fee became too expensive.

tasks.label: Reason 2
tasks.requirement: Give a second reason for canceling.
tasks.example: The workers often arrived later than scheduled.

tasks.label: Suggestion
tasks.requirement: Make one suggestion for improvement.
tasks.example: You should inform customers earlier when schedules change.

vocabulary.example: Customer service is very important.
The team was scheduled to arrive at 9 A.M.
The monthly fee was too high.
You should inform customers earlier.

patterns: Thank you for asking for feedback.
sampleAnswer: Dear Premier Landscaping,
Thank you for asking for our feedback.
The main reason we canceled the service is that the monthly fee became too expensive.
Another reason is that the workers often arrived later than scheduled.
You should inform customers earlier when schedules change.
Sincerely,
Landerson Law Offices

sampleBlanks.sentence: The workers often arrived later than _____.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Nhân viên thường đến muộn hơn lịch.

sampleBlanks.sentence: You should inform customers earlier when _____ change.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Bạn nên báo khách hàng sớm hơn khi lịch thay đổi.

guidedOutline.opening: Thank you for asking for our feedback.

prompts.title: Tuition assistance

email.subject: Application for tuition assistance
body: Ms. Yoshida,
Thank you for your interest in our company's program that helps employees pay for educational expenses.
Please provide information about the course you wish to take and how it relates to your job and professional development.
Let me know if you have any further questions about the program.
Michael Dunn
translationVi: Cô Yoshida,
Cảm ơn cô đã quan tâm đến chương trình hỗ trợ chi phí học tập cho nhân viên của công ty.
Vui lòng cung cấp thông tin về khóa học cô muốn tham gia và khóa học liên quan thế nào đến công việc, phát triển nghề nghiệp.
Hãy cho tôi biết nếu cô có thêm câu hỏi về chương trình.
Michael Dunn

prompts.roleVi: Bạn là Mariko Yoshida, nhân viên xin hỗ trợ học phí.

tasks.label: Information 1
tasks.requirement: Give information about the course.
tasks.example: I would like to take an advanced accounting course.

tasks.label: Information 2
tasks.requirement: Explain how the course relates to your job.
tasks.example: The course will help me prepare more accurate financial reports.

tasks.label: Question
tasks.requirement: Ask one question about the program.
tasks.example: When is the deadline for submitting the application?

vocabulary.example: The company helps with educational expenses.
The course relates to my current job.
This course supports my professional development.

patterns: Thank you for considering my request.
sampleAnswer: Dear Mr. Dunn,
Thank you for your message about tuition assistance.
I would like to take an advanced accounting course at City College.
This course will help me prepare more accurate financial reports for my department.
Could you tell me when the application deadline is?
Thank you for considering my request.
Mariko Yoshida

prompts.title: Lost wallet

email.subject: My wallet
body: Thanks for your phone message telling me that my wallet was found in one of your taxis this morning.
You said I can come get it at your main office.
Please tell me where this office is located and what I need to do to claim my wallet.
translationVi: Cảm ơn tin nhắn thoại cho biết ví của tôi được tìm thấy trong một taxi của công ty sáng nay.
Quý công ty nói tôi có thể đến văn phòng chính để nhận lại.
Vui lòng cho tôi biết văn phòng ở đâu và tôi cần làm gì để nhận lại ví.

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you work for Greenline Taxi Service. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ONE instruction.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là nhân viên Greenline Taxi Service.

tasks.label: Information 1
tasks.requirement: Give information about the office location.
tasks.example: Our main office is located on the second floor of Central Station.

tasks.label: Information 2
tasks.requirement: Give information about office hours.
tasks.example: The office is open from 8 A.M. to 6 P.M.

tasks.label: Instruction
tasks.requirement: Tell the customer what to bring.
tasks.example: Please bring some identification with you.

vocabulary.example: The office is located on the second floor.
Our office hours are from 8 A.M. to 6 P.M.

vocabulary.meaningVi: mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân
vocabulary.example: Please bring some identification.
You can claim your wallet at the office.

patterns: We are glad we found your wallet.
sampleAnswer: Dear Mr. Cruz,
We are glad we found your wallet.
Our main office is located on the second floor of Central Station.

Please bring some identification with you when you come to claim your wallet.
Sincerely,
Greenline Taxi Service

prompts.title: Travel reimbursement

email.subject: Travel reimbursement
body: I know that I can be reimbursed for certain business trip costs but not others.
I kept records of everything I spent while on business for our company in Tokyo.
Could you give me the details on the company policy for getting refunds for the money I spent?
Thank you,
Vishal
translationVi: Tôi biết rằng tôi có thể được hoàn tiền cho một số chi phí công tác, nhưng không phải tất cả.
Tôi đã giữ lại hồ sơ của mọi khoản chi trong chuyến công tác ở Tokyo.
Vui lòng cho tôi biết chi tiết chính sách hoàn tiền của công ty.
Cảm ơn,
Vishal

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you work in the finance office. In your e-mail, give THREE details.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là nhân viên phòng tài chính trả lời Vishal về chính sách hoàn tiền công tác.

tasks.label: Detail 1
tasks.requirement: Explain which costs can be reimbursed.
tasks.example: The company reimburses food, travel, and hotel costs.

tasks.label: Detail 2
tasks.requirement: Explain that expenses must match the approved budget.
tasks.example: Your expenses must be within the budget approved by your manager.

tasks.label: Detail 3
tasks.requirement: Explain what documents are needed.
tasks.example: You need to submit receipts for the total amount you spent.

vocabulary.example: You can be reimbursed for travel costs.
The expenses must be within the approved budget.
Please submit all receipts.
Write the total amount on the form.

sampleAnswer: Hi Vishal,
The company reimburses some food, travel, and hotel costs.
Your manager must approve a budget before the trip, and your expenses must be within that budget.
You also need to submit receipts for the total amount you spent.
If you have any other questions, please contact us again.
Best,
Joo-Won Choi

prompts.title: Employee awards dinner

email.subject: Employee awards dinner
body: Hi Susan,
I'm coordinating the employee awards dinner this year.
I know you've done this in the past.
Can you tell me about your experience planning previous dinners?
Also, I'd appreciate any suggestions that you may have.
John Dembo
translationVi: Chào Susan,
Tôi đang phụ trách bữa tối trao giải cho nhân viên năm nay.
Tôi biết cô từng làm việc này trước đây.
Cô có thể chia sẻ kinh nghiệm tổ chức các bữa tối trước không?
Tôi cũng rất cảm kích nếu cô có đề xuất nào.
John Dembo

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and make ONE suggestion.

tasks.label: Information 1
tasks.requirement: Give information about a past planning choice.
tasks.example: We held the dinner at a hotel in order to save money.

tasks.label: Information 2
tasks.requirement: Give information about available options.
tasks.example: There are several good restaurants in the area to choose from.

tasks.label: Suggestion
tasks.requirement: Make one suggestion for planning the dinner.
tasks.example: It is best to send invitations early so that employees can reserve the date.

vocabulary.meaningVi: phụ trách điều phối sự kiện

In the past, we held the dinner at a hotel in order to save money.

I hope this helps.
Best,
Susan

prompts.title: Employee training session

email.subject: Employee training session
body: Dear Ms. Mayer,
I received a memo telling me to attend a customer service training session next Saturday.
That is outside my normal working hours.
As you are my manager, could you please tell me more about this training and why I'm being asked to take it?
Thanks,
Sheila Ramsey

Tôi nhận được thông báo yêu cầu tham gia buổi đào tạo chăm sóc khách hàng vào thứ Bảy tới.
Thời gian đó nằm ngoài giờ làm việc bình thường của tôi.
Vì cô là quản lý của tôi, cô có thể cho tôi biết thêm về buổi đào tạo và lý do tôi được yêu cầu tham gia không?
Cảm ơn,
Sheila Ramsey

tasks.label: Information 2
tasks.requirement: Give information about what the training will teach.
tasks.example: It will teach you how to answer customer questions.

tasks.label: Reason

vocabulary.example: The training session is on Saturday.

vocabulary.example: The training is outside normal working hours.

vocabulary.meaningVi: trả lời câu hỏi của khách hàng

The Saturday training session is about our new products.

Best,
Eric

prompts.title: Common customer complaints

email.subject: Common customer complaints
body: Hi everybody,
